pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Upanandassa Sakyaputtassa dūtena cīvaracetāpanaṃ pāhesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.3: iminā cīvaracetāpanena cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā ayyaṃ Upanandaṃ cīvarena acchādehīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.4: atha kho so dūto yenāyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Upanandaṃ Sakyaputtaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.5: idaṃ kho bhante āyasmantaṃ uddissa cīvaracetāpanaṃ ābhataṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.7: evaṃ vutte āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto taṃ dūtaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.8: na kho mayaṃ āvuso cīvaracetāpanaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma, cīvarañ ca kho mayaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma kālena kappiyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.9: evaṃ vutte so dūto āyasmantaṃ Upanandaṃ Sakyaputtaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.11: tena kho pana samayena aññataro upāsako ārāmaṃ agamāsi kenacid eva karaṇīyena.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.12: atha kho āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto taṃ dūtaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.13: eso kho āvuso upāsako bhikkhūnaṃ veyyāvaccakaro 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.14: atha kho so dūto taṃ upāsakaṃ saññāpetvā yenāyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Upanandaṃ Sakyaputtaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.15: yaṃ kho bhante āyasmā veyyāvaccakaraṃ niddisi saññatto so mayā,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.16: upasaṃkamatu āyasmā kālena, cīvarena taṃ acchādessatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.17: tena kho pana samayena so mahāmatto āyasmato Upanandassa Sakyaputtassa santike dūtaṃ pāhesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.18: paribhuñjatu ayyo taṃ cīvaraṃ, icchāma mayaṃ ayyena taṃ cīvaraṃ paribhuttan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.19: atha kho āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto taṃ upāsakaṃ na kiñci avacāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.20: dutiyam pi kho so mahāmatto āyasmato Upanandassa Sakyaputtassa santike dūtaṃ pāhesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.22: dutiyam pi kho āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto taṃ upāsakaṃ na kiñci avacāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.23: tatiyam pi kho so mahāmatto āyasmato Upanandassa Sakyaputtassa santike dūtaṃ pāhesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.1: tena kho pana samayena negamassa samayo hoti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.2: negamena ca katikā katā hoti yo pacchā āgacchati paññāsaṃ bandho 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.3: atha kho āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto yena so upāsako ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā taṃ upāsakaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.5: ajjuṇho bhante āgamehi, ajja negamassa samayo hoti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.6: negamena ca katikā katā hoti yo pacchā āgacchati paññāsaṃ bandho 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.7: ajj' eva me āvuso cīvaraṃ dehīti ovaṭṭikāya parāmasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.8: atha kho so upāsako āyasmatā Upanandena Sakyaputtena nippīḷiyamāno āyasmato Upanandassa Sakyaputtassa cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā pacchā agamāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.10: kissa tvaṃ ayyo pacchā āgato, paññāsaṃ jino 'sīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.11: atha kho so upāsako tesaṃ manussānaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.14: na yimesaṃ sukaraṃ veyyāvaccaṃ pi kātuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.17: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.18: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te . . . vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.19: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto upāsakena
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.21: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.28: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--;
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.29: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha: ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.1: bhikkhuṃ pan' eva uddissa rājā vā rājabhoggo vā brāhmaṇo vā gahapatiko vā dūtena cīvaracetāpanaṃ pahiṇeyya
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.2: iminā cīvaracetāpanena cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ cīvarena acchādehīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.3: so ce dūto taṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.4: idaṃ kho bhante āyasmantaṃ uddissa cīvaracetāpanaṃ ābhataṃ, paṭiggaṇhātu āyasmā cīvaracetāpanan ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.5: tena bhikkhunā so dūto evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.6: na kho mayaṃ āvuso cīvaracetāpanaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma, cīvarañ ca kho mayaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma kālena kappiyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.7: so ce dūto taṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadeyya:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.9: cīvaratthikena bhikkhave bhikkhunā veyyāvaccakaro niddisitabbo ārāmiko vā upāsako vā
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.11: so ce dūto taṃ veyyāvaccakaraṃ saññāpetvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.12: yaṃ kho bhante āyasmā veyyāvaccakaraṃ niddisi saññatto so mayā, upasaṃkamatu āyasmā kālena, cīvarena taṃ acchādessatīti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.13: cīvaratthikena bhikkhave bhikkhunā veyyāvaccakaro upasaṃkamitvā dvittikkhattuṃ codetabbo sāretabbo
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.15: dvittikkhattuṃ codiyamāno sāriyamāno taṃ cīvaraṃ abhinipphādeyya, icc etaṃ kusalaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.16: no ce abhinipphādeyya, catukkhattuṃ pañcakkhattuṃ chakkhattuparamaṃ tuṇhibhūtena uddissa ṭhātabbaṃ;
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.17: catukkhattuṃ pañcakkhattuṃ chakkhattuparamaṃ tuṇhibhūto uddissa tiṭṭhamāno taṃ cīvaraṃ abhinipphādeyya, icc etaṃ kusalaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.18: tato ce uttariṃ vāyamamāno taṃ cīvaraṃ abhinipphādeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.19: noce abhinipphādeyya, yat 'assa cīvaracetāpanaṃ ābhataṃ tattha sāmaṃ vā gantabbaṃ dūto vā pāhetabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.20: yaṃ kho tumhe āyasmanto bhikkhuṃ uddissa cīvaracetāpanaṃ pahiṇittha na taṃ tassa bhikkhuno kiñci atthaṃ anubhoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.21: yuñjant' āyasmanto sakaṃ, mā vo sakaṃ vinassā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.2: bhikkhuss' atthāya bhikkhuṃ ārammaṇaṃ karitvā bhikkhuṃ acchādetukāmo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.10: ṭhapetvā rājaṃ rājabhoggaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ avaseso gahapatiko nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.12: hiraññaṃ vā suvaṇṇaṃ vā muttā vā maṇi vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.19: so ce dūto taṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.20: idaṃ kho bhante āyasmantaṃ uddissa cīvaracetāpanaṃ ābhataṃ, paṭiggaṇhātu āyasmā cīvaracetāpanan ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.21: tena bhikkhunā so dūto evaṃ assa vacanīyo . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.27: na vattabbo: tassa dehīti vā so vā nikkhipissati so vā parivattissati so vā cetāpessatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.28: so ce dūto taṃ veyyāvaccakaraṃ saññāpetvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.29: yaṃ kho bhante āyasmā veyyāvaccakaraṃ niddisi saññatto so mayā, upasaṃkamatu āyasmā kālena, cīvarena taṃ acchādessatīti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.30: cīvaratthikena bhikkhave bhikkhunā veyyāvaccakaro upasaṃkamitvā dvittikkhattuṃ codetabbo sāretabbo
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.32: na vattabbo: dehi me cīvaraṃ āhara me cīvaraṃ parivattehi me cīvaraṃ cetāpehi me cīvaran ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.36: no ce abhinipphādeti, tattha gantvā tuṇhibhūtena uddissa ṭhātabbaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.37: na āsane nisīditabbaṃ na āmisaṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.39: kiṃkāraṇā āgato 'sīti pucchiyamāno jānāhi āvuso 'ti vattabbo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.40: sace āsane vā nisīdati āmisaṃ vā paṭiggaṇhāti dhammaṃ vā bhāsati, ṭhānaṃ bhañjati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.2.1: tato ce uttariṃ vāyamamāno taṃ cīvaraṃ abhinipphādeti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.2.4: nissajjitabbaṃ saṃghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.2.7: idaṃ me bhante cīvaraṃ atirekatikkhattuṃ codanāya atirekachakkhattuṃ ṭhānena abhinipphāditaṃ nissaggiyaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.2.12: no ce abhinipphādeyya yat' assa cīvaracetāpanaṃ ābhataṃ tattha sāmaṃ vā gantabbaṃ dūto vā pāhetabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.2.13: yaṃ kho tumhe āyasmanto bhikkhuṃ uddissa cīvaracetāpanaṃ pahiṇittha na taṃ tassa bhikkhuno kiñci atthaṃ anubhoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.2.14: yuñjant' āyasmanto sakaṃ mā vo sakaṃ vinassā 'ti;
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.3.1: atirekatikkhattuṃ codanāya atirekachakkhattuṃ ṭhānena atirekasaññī abhinipphādeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.3.2: atirekatikkhattuṃ codanāya atirekachakkhattuṃ ṭhānena vematiko abhinipphādeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.3.3: atirekatikkhattuṃ codanāya atirekachakkhattuṃ ṭhānena ūnakasaññī abhinipphādeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.3.4: ūnakatikkhattuṃ codanāya ūnakachakkhattuṃ ṭhānena atirekasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.3.5: ūnakatikkhattuṃ codanāya ūnakachakkhattuṃ ṭhānena vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.3.6: ūnakatikkhattuṃ codanāya ūnakachakkhattuṃ ṭhānena ūnakasaññī, anāpatti. ||3||
